newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's 30-yr bond yield trades below U.S. 30-yr.
newsitem.headline: Canada's 30-yr bond yield trades below U.S. 30-yr.

text.p: Canada's 30-year benchmark bond traded with lower yield than its U.S. counterpart for the first time ever on Thursday.
The move brought the entire Canadian yield curve below the U.S. curve for the first time ever, an event which would have been unthinkable just a few years ago.
Analysts earlier this week predicted that Canada's growing fiscal and monetary credibility would allow the entire Canadian yield curve to trade below the U.S. curve.
Canada's 30-year benchmark rose C$1.66 to C$115.87 to yield 6.757 percent on Thursday. The U.S. 30-year bond was up 29/32 to yield 6.77.
